title: Notice on Binance Spot API Update (2025-04-07)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Spot API will gradually roll out the following changes on request weight starting from  2025-04-07 (UTC) . The process will take approximately one week to complete.  Change on request weight The request weight for  myTrades  was 20 regardless of the parameters provided. Now with  orderId  provided, the request weight is set to 5. Affected requests: REST API GET /api/v3/myTrades WebSocket API myTrades Binance Spot API will implement the following updates at  2025-04-24 07:00 (UTC).  Behavior when querying and/or canceling with  orderId  and  origClientOrderId/cancelOrigClientOrderId For more details, please refer to the “For More Information” section below. Affected requests: REST API GET /api/v3/order DELETE /api/v3/order POST /api/v3/order/cancelReplace WebSocket API order.status order.cancel order.cancelReplace FIX API OrderCancelRequest  <F> OrderCancelRequestAndNewOrderSingle  <XCN> Behavior when canceling with  listOrderId  and  listClientOrderId For more details, please refer to the “For More Information” section below.  Affected requests: REST API DELETE /api/v3/orderList WebSocket API orderList.cancel In addition, Binance Spot API has made the following updates on User Data Streams. Change on User Data Streams Receiving user data streams on wss://stream.binance.com:9443 using a  listenKey  is now deprecated. This feature will be removed from our systems at a later date. Users should get user data updates by subscribing to the  User Data Stream on the WebSocket API . This should offer slightly better performance (lower latency). This requires the use of an Ed25519 API Key. In a future update, information about the base WebSocket endpoint for the User Data Streams will be removed. In a future update, the following requests will be removed from the documentation: POST /api/v3/userDataStream PUT /api/v3/userDataStream DELETE /api/v3/userDataStream userDataStream.start userDataStream.ping userDataStream.stop The  User Data Stream documentation  will remain as reference for the payloads you can receive. Notes: API users can now test new updates in  Binance Spot Testnet . Trading will  not  be impacted by the aforementioned updates.  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. For More Information:  Binance Spot API Change Log Binance Spot GitHub API Docs  Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-04-07
